global.description: Platform values (global.okdp): the context's layers, the platform's (platform.yaml) then its project's (project.yaml), never an instance's.

cpu.title: CPU (vCPU)
cpu.description: CPU request of the seed job in vCPU. The limit is twice the request.

memoryGi.title: Memory (GiB)
memoryGi.description: Memory request of the seed job in GiB. The limit is twice the request.

storage.title: Object store
storage.description: S3 store where the medallion buckets live: the name of a connection, or of an output of another instance of the namespace. The job creates the buckets with its own identity: no claim, a claimed bucket's identity reaches its bucket only.

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: S3 identity of the seed job, one that creates buckets. Secret with keys: accessKey, secretKey. Empty: the storage connection's credentials Secret (secretRef).

trino.title: Trino
trino.description: Trino carrying the bronze catalog: the name of a connection, or of the trino output of an instance of the namespace (its instance's name).

trinoOidcSecretRef.title: Trino OAuth client secret
trinoOidcSecretRef.description: OAuth client used against Trino. Secret with keys: client_id, client_secret.

polaris.title: Iceberg REST catalog
polaris.description: Polaris where the silver and gold catalogs are provisioned: the name of a connection, or of the iceberg-catalog output of an instance of the namespace (its instance's name).

sparkEventsLogDir.title: Spark events log dir
sparkEventsLogDir.description: Spark History log directory, created if missing.

polarisRealms.title: Realms
polarisRealms.description: Realms model applied by polaris-admin: catalogs, roles, principals. One principal per realm must carry the catalog_admin role and a credentialsSecret.

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream chart this chart renders, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

okdp-examples.title: okdp-examples
okdp-examples.description: Values of the okdp-examples chart 1.3.0 (oci://quay.io/okdp/charts/okdp-examples), for example image, job.backoffLimit, resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, extra commands or extraFiles. Refused: fullnameOverride, job.annotations, extraFiles.polaris-catalogs. Appended to the lists this chart sets: extraEnvRaw, extraVolumes, extraVolumeMounts.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
